prompt: An organization wants to ensure that all emails coming from the domain "trustedpartner.com" with a size greater than 5MB are directly moved to the "Large Attachments" folder. Which Sieve rule will accomplish this?
choices: if anyof address :is "from" "*.trustedpartner.com", size :over 5120 { fileinto "Large Attachments"; }
explanation: The rule matches messages from the trustedpartner.com domain that are over 5120 KB (5MB) and files them into the "Large Attachments" folder using fileinto.
